features.name: Rillito River Park Path
features.description: Rillito River Park Path is a paved, shared-use segment following the Rillito River corridor and connecting into Pima County's larger Chuck Huckelberry Loop network.

features.name: Chuck Huckelberry Loop Connection
features.description: The Chuck Huckelberry Loop connection links the Rillito corridor to a countywide network of paved shared-use paths used by people walking, rolling, running, cycling, and riding horses on designated sections.
